messages:
Anika: @here FYI BlueHarbor just pushed our pickup window for the APAC dedicated racks by ~48h. Customer-facing commits could be impacted if we don't reprioritize.
Marco: Ugh. Which manifests are affected? sku/rack counts?
Anika: 3 racks total: RH-GPU-8-64 x2, RH-GPU-8-128 x1. Manifest IDs: BH-4421, BH-4422, BH-4423. BlueHarbor says chassis hold at origin port due to crane availability.
Marco: Copy. I'll ping the carrier and check alternate pickup windows. If we can move one rack to the Monday freight slot we should. @Jules any infra flexibility on a partial rollout?
Jules: Partial rollout OK for canary traffic. Need confirmation which model versions are on those racks so we avoid mismatched quantization profiles. Can you dump the rack mapping?
Anika: Sending mapping in a sec.
Anika: ```
BH-4421: cluster-nyc-ded-01 -> models: rwv1-small,rwv1-small-q4
BH-4422: cluster-ams-ded-03 -> models: rwv2-medium
BH-4423: cluster-sin-ded-02 -> models: rwv2-medium,rwv2-large
```
Priya: Heads-up — three enterprise customers have reservations tied to BH-4423. We should open customer comms now if risk remains high. I can draft but need the exact ETA window change.
Marco: BlueHarbor told us ETA slip +48h, pickup now Tuesday 06:00 local. There's a chance customs inspection could add +24. Not great.
Samir: From finance side, if we can't meet SLAs we should prepare pro-rata credits for those customers. Do we have CLAs on file that define credit calculations?
Priya: Yes, but let's not jump to credits yet. Draft proactive message: apologize, outline mitigation (partial rollout + rearrange shipments), promise a follow-up with firm ETA. I can send if we lock the mitigation plan.
Anika: Mitigation options I see:
1) Move BH-4422 -> alternate carrier (expedite) to preserve canary.
2) Swap BH-4423 racks between two customers (one takes the smaller capacity temporarily) — requires sales signoff.
3) Delay non-critical rollout and do patch-only hotfix routing.
Which do we prefer?
Marco: Option 1 is top priority. I'll get quotes from AltFreight and SeaSprint, ETA +24h vs +72h and cost delta is ~30%. Trying AltFreight now.
Jules: If option 1 works, we need a hot-cache routing rule so affected customers see consistent latency. Ops note: prefix caching for those clusters should be extended by 12h to smooth transition.
OpsBot: [deploy-bot] Created ticket PART-8674 for carrier fallback and PART-8675 for cache extension. Links: https://tickets.redwood/PART-8674, https://tickets.redwood/PART-8675 :white_check_mark:
Anika: @Priya please hold customer comm draft; wait til Marco confirms carrier quote. @Samir can you pre-calc credit scenarios for BH-4423 reservations so we're ready if needed?
Samir: On it. Will post numbers in PART-8674 comment.
Priya: Got it. Ill prep a two-paragraph message template (no credits yet) and stage it in the comms doc.
Marco: AltFreight confirmed space for BH-4422 with pickup tomorrow 22:00 local, cost +28%. SeaSprint would be +72h. Recommend we re-route BH-4422 immediately.
Anika: Good. Marco, execute reroute and update PART-8674 with shipping manifest and new tracking. Jules, coordinate cache extension PART-8675.
Jules: Will do. Tagging infra lead to approve short-term routing change.
Anika: Thanks all. If BlueHarbor updates pickup again, we escalate to vendor ops and legal. For now: reroute BH-4422, monitor BH-4421/4423, don't send customer comms until Marco confirms final ETA for BH-4423. :eyes:
Priya: Draft ready to go once Marco confirms. :thumbsup:
Marco: Reroute executed for BH-4422. New tracking: AF-990112. Updated PART-8674 comment.
Anika: Closing loop — we'll reconvene if any further slips. Filing a lessons-learned doc after post-mortem. Thanks everyone. :shipit:
